          Innovating at the Intersection of Physics, Data Science, and Research Operations

        <p>
          🚀 At Oura, I lead research operations, unlocking scalable data collection for next-gen health sensing. My team drives groundbreaking research, from internal studies to external collaborations, leading to scientific publications and validating Oura's capabilities in <a href="https://ouraring.com/blog/category/oura-101/oura-in-research/">health sensing</a>.
        </p>
        <p>
          🧠 Before Oura, I earned my PhD in Applied Physics at Harvard, co-founding the iconic <a href="https://pll.harvard.edu/course/science-and-cooking">Science & Cooking</a> course. Fascinated by the quantified self movement, I joined <a href="https://www.fitbit.com/">Fitbit</a>, building business intelligence and data science systems. Later, as an early member of <a href="https://www.indigoag.com/">Indigo Ag</a>'s Innovation Team, I helped shape what is now their carbon credits program. I love building teams of curious, ambitious people to tackle complex problems.
        </p>
        <p>
          🏋️‍♂️ Outside work, you'll find me at 5:30 AM CrossFit, chasing PRs, or running weekend half-marathons. I'm an avid reader, a scientific cook, and endlessly curious about the intersection of physics, psychology, randomness, and human performance.
        </p>
        <p>
          *All opinions are my own and not reflective of Oura or previous employers.
